harden_marketplace_relations_and_public_orders
statements:
-- Defense-in-depth: prevent records from referencing non-existent sellers.
DO $$
BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'psb_orders_seller_id_fkey') THEN
    ALTER TABLE public.psb_orders
      ADD CONSTRAINT psb_orders_seller_id_fkey
      FOREIGN KEY (seller_id) REFERENCES public.psb_sellers(seller_id)
      ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT;
  END IF;

  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'psb_seller_offers_seller_id_fkey') THEN
    ALTER TABLE public.psb_seller_offers
      ADD CONSTRAINT psb_seller_offers_seller_id_fkey
      FOREIGN KEY (seller_id) REFERENCES public.psb_sellers(seller_id)
      ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE;
  END IF;

  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'psb_seller_shipping_rules_seller_id_fkey') THEN
    ALTER TABLE public.psb_seller_shipping_rules
      ADD CONSTRAINT psb_seller_shipping_rules_seller_id_fkey
      FOREIGN KEY (seller_id) REFERENCES public.psb_sellers(seller_id)
      ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE;
  END IF;

  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'psb_seller_shipping_settings_seller_id_fkey') THEN
    ALTER TABLE public.psb_seller_shipping_settings
      ADD CONSTRAINT psb_seller_shipping_settings_seller_id_fkey
      FOREIGN KEY (seller_id) REFERENCES public.psb_sellers(seller_id)
      ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE;
  END IF;
END $$;

-- Structural validation for new and updated orders.
DO $$
BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'psb_orders_status_check') THEN
    ALTER TABLE public.psb_orders ADD CONSTRAINT psb_orders_status_check CHECK (
      status = ANY (ARRAY[
        'aguardando-confirmacao'::text,
        'aprovado-para-pagamento'::text,
        'pago'::text,
        'em-separacao'::text,
        'enviado'::text,
        'concluido'::text,
        'reprovado'::text,
        'cancelado'::text
      ])
    );
  END IF;

  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'psb_orders_number_format_check') THEN
    ALTER TABLE public.psb_orders ADD CONSTRAINT psb_orders_number_format_check
      CHECK (order_number ~ '^PSB-[0-9]{8}$');
  END IF;

  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'psb_orders_subtotal_nonnegative_check') THEN
    ALTER TABLE public.psb_orders ADD CONSTRAINT psb_orders_subtotal_nonnegative_check
      CHECK (subtotal >= 0);
  END IF;

  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'psb_orders_json_types_check') THEN
    ALTER TABLE public.psb_orders ADD CONSTRAINT psb_orders_json_types_check CHECK (
      jsonb_typeof(customer) = 'object'
      AND jsonb_typeof(items) = 'array'
      AND jsonb_typeof(timeline) = 'array'
      AND jsonb_typeof(order_payload) = 'object'
    );
  END IF;
END $$;

-- Anonymous checkout is still allowed, but only for a legitimate initial order shape.
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS psb_orders_insert_public ON public.psb_orders;
CREATE POLICY psb_orders_insert_public
ON public.psb_orders
FOR INSERT
TO anon, authenticated
WITH CHECK (
  status = 'aguardando-confirmacao'
  AND payment_released = false
  AND source = 'site'
  AND order_number ~ '^PSB-[0-9]{8}$'
  AND subtotal >= 0
  AND subtotal <= 1000000
  AND jsonb_typeof(customer) = 'object'
  AND jsonb_typeof(items) = 'array'
  AND jsonb_array_length(items) BETWEEN 1 AND 200
  AND jsonb_typeof(timeline) = 'array'
  AND octet_length(customer::text) <= 20000
  AND octet_length(items::text) <= 150000
  AND octet_length(timeline::text) <= 50000
  AND octet_length(order_payload::text) <= 300000
  AND customer ? 'name'
  AND customer ? 'phone'
  AND customer ? 'city'
  AND length(btrim(customer->>'name')) BETWEEN 2 AND 120
  AND length(btrim(customer->>'phone')) BETWEEN 8 AND 30
  AND length(btrim(customer->>'city')) BETWEEN 2 AND 160
);
